title: Extension on original coordinates
statement: Let $n$ and $r$ be nonnegative integers, let $a\in\{-1,1\}^n$ be an assignment, and let $b\in\{-1,1\}^r$ be an auxiliary assignment. In the concatenated assignment on $n+r$ coordinates, coordinate $i$ equals $a_i$ for every $i<n$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ and the auxiliary coordinate count are natural numbers
An assignment on the original $n$ coordinates is given
An auxiliary assignment on the additional coordinates is given
